_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. A leaf with "var" takes its value from that variable in css-vars.json, resolved inside its "owner": site = the --color-*/--sp-* palette and scales on www.anthropic.com and claude.com :root; docs = the --cds-* theme on docs.claude.com (.cds-root light, .cds-dark-scope[data-mode="dark"] dark, resolving to the --cds-gray-*/--cds-blue-* ramps on :where(:root, :host)). A leaf with "value" carries a measured value and names the measurement in "source". Every leaf carries $extensions.source. The marketing and product pages are light-only ivory surfaces; only the docs ship a dark theme, so the dark set covers the docs' core roles.

500.description: #d97757, the Anthropic clay. Sparingly used on the public surface: the footer prompt-bar submit button (as its darker interactive twin), pictograms, brand accents. The product pages' --theme-accent-clay-primary.

600.description: #c6613f, the darker interactive clay (clay-emphasized on docs): the measured fill of the footer's variant-brand submit button and the declared hover shade

clay.$description: The signature orange. It is an accent, not a UI workhorse: buttons on the public surface are near-black, clay shows up on brand moments and pictograms.
